Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de electrocasnice, electrice și electronice, Servicii de date pentru sisteme IT și Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT
Miele Tehnica is a subsidiary of Miele & Cie. KG, Germany. We produce electronic components for a wide range of Miele appliances, such as washing machines, tumble dryers, vacuum cleaners, ovens and others. The products Miele offers to its customers set the standards for durability, performance, ease of use, energy efficiency, design and service.
 At Miele , we're expanding our IT teams and looking for an Application Specialist Systems Engineering who is passionate about enterprise applications, engineering processes, and innovative technologies.
 Responsibilities 
Configure, maintain and enhance PTC RV&S and potential successor applications
Build and maintain integrations with enterprise systems and data interfaces
Translate business needs into structured system solutions
Identify improvement potential and implement releases, upgrades and functional enhancements
Ensure stable operations through maintenance, updates, monitoring, root-cause analysis and incident coordination
Advise the Product Owner on functional development, solution architecture and roadmap topics
Ensure IT security and data protection for web-based services with internal and external partners
Manage users, groups, roles, permissions and access-control concepts across the platform
Design user training and provide user consulting
 Skills 
University degree in Computer Science, Engineering or comparable qualification
Solid understanding of Requirements and Systems Engineering principles
Experience with PTC RV&S administration
Practical programming/scripting experience with Java, JavaScript, Python, REST APIs, SQL and web technologies
Experience developing and maintaining interfaces between enterprise systems
Understanding of IT architecture, software architecture and platform lifecycle management
Knowledge of IT security, network security and data protection for web applications
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, proactive working style
Ability to translate business needs into practical system solutions
Stakeholder communication and collaboration skills across business, IT and external partners
Ability to design user training and consulting formats
Very good English skills (German is a plus)
Hands-on experience with AI and basic knowledge about agentic frameworks
 If you are looking for a long-term career where your talent is appreciated, then we would love for you to join our team!
